description: RETBAT crystallizes in the triclinic crystal system with space group P -1. Reported CIF formula moiety: C30 H78 Br4 N3 O4 Si6 Yb3. From the CIF bond table, Yb1 (Yb) has 2 O neighbors; Yb2 (Yb) has 2 O neighbors; Yb3 (Yb) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 3 pairs, 1 components; largest component is a network with cycles with approximately planar metal-site arrangement. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 3.516-3.522 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 110.63-111.10°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links.
